At both Terminal 1 and Terminal 2, we wait with a name board at the arrivals hall exit on the 1st floor. Korean Air and some other airlines arrive at Terminal 2, so please give us your flight number when booking.
Once you leave the arrivals hall, just look for the driver holding your name board. The driver already has your destination from the booking, so there is nothing to explain on the day.
Price and booking

Kuma Travel's Incheon Airport transfer to central Seoul is a fixed KRW 150,000 (Staria, up to 6 people, per vehicle). The price stays the same late at night, early in the morning and in traffic, and round-trip bookings get 10% off.
It is a private vehicle carrying only your booked party. We track flight delays ourselves, so there is no extra charge.
You can book via LINE, phone, email or the inquiry form, in Japanese or Korean.
Distance and time from Incheon Airport to main areas
Hongdae：48.7 km, about 48 minutes by car
Myeongdong：55.6 km, about 55 minutes by car
Walkerhill：68.0 km, about 73 minutes by car
Samseong/COEX：63.4 km, about 63 minutes by car
Dongdaemun：58.1 km, about 58 minutes by car
Itaewon：55.0 km, about 56 minutes by car
Figures are road distance from Terminal 1 and estimates for times without traffic. Kuma Travel's transfer is a fixed KRW 150,000 to any area in central Seoul.
Common requests for Incheon Airport to central Seoul
For Lotte Hotel, Nobless Tourist Hotel or any other hotel, send us the name or address and we will take you to the front door.
With Kuma Travel you can book over LINE in Japanese or Korean, and when you reach Incheon Airport the driver will be waiting with your name board. There is no need to use your phone after you arrive.
The price is confirmed when you book. It will not change after you arrive, and the vehicle is private, carrying only your booked party.
Kuma Travel's transfer runs to your flight's arrival time. Even if immigration or baggage claim at Incheon Airport takes a while, you can go to your hotel without worrying about a timetable.

From Incheon Airport to central Seoul, the road distance from Terminal 1 is 54.5 km, about 54 minutes when there is no traffic. City traffic tends to build on weekdays 7:00–9:00 and 17:00–19:00 and on weekend afternoons, and the trip can take about 1.5 times as long, but the price does not change.
The KRW 150,000 fare can be split among your group, so it comes to KRW 37,500 per person for 4. Book a round trip and get 10% off the total.

Send your flight number, group size and hotel name via LINE.
Arrival

At both Terminal 1 and Terminal 2, we wait with a name board at the arrivals hall exit on the 1st floor. Korean Air and some other airlines arrive at Terminal 2, so please give us your flight number when booking.

We load your luggage and head to your hotel. There are no vehicle changes along the way.
Hotel
Drop-off at the front door. You can leave your luggage at the front desk even before check-in.
